files.compose.yaml:
services:
  proof:
    image: docker.io/library/busybox@sha256:bdf57e528e45e4433820e045b29b4597825a1c9e38353532d90a01445013f82e
    pull_policy: never
    command: ["tail", "-f", "/dev/null"]
    network_mode: none
    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: .
        target: /fixture
        read_only: true
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "sh", "-c", "grep -qx stage=after /fixture/proof.txt"]
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 1s
      retries: 5

commands.prepare: test ! -e g5-origin-source && test ! -e g5-origin.git && test ! -e g5-native && mkdir g5-origin-source && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false init --object-format=sha1 --initial-branch=main g5-origin-source
commands.origin: chmod 0644 g5-origin-source/bounded.py g5-origin-source/test_bounded.py g5-origin-source/proof.txt g5-origin-source/compose.yaml && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-origin-source add -- bounded.py test_bounded.py proof.txt compose.yaml && GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='EZHarness fixture' GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid' GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='EZHarness fixture' GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid' GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='946684800 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='946684800 +0000' git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-origin-source commit -m 'Incus local-origin fixture v1' && test "$(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-origin-source rev-parse HEAD)" = 9120384776b04560f44be0dde3eae9dcf47829b0 && test "$(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-origin-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = 7345fc09b6fc880b6e015d350b2c6fb897ac32ec && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false clone --bare g5-origin-source g5-origin.git
commands.checkout: git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false clone --no-local g5-origin.git g5-native && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native checkout --detach 9120384776b04560f44be0dde3eae9dcf47829b0 && test "$(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native rev-parse HEAD)" = 9120384776b04560f44be0dde3eae9dcf47829b0 && test "$(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = 7345fc09b6fc880b6e015d350b2c6fb897ac32ec
commands.tests: cd g5-native && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_bounded.py
commands.composeUp: docker compose -p g5-native -f g5-native/compose.yaml up -d --pull never --wait --wait-timeout 30
commands.composeTest: docker compose -p g5-native -f g5-native/compose.yaml run --pull never --rm proof sh -c 'grep -qx stage=after /fixture/proof.txt && printf ezh-compose-ok'
commands.commit: git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native config user.name 'Incus qualification' && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native config user.email qualification@example.invalid && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native add -- bounded.py proof.txt && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native commit -m 'Native fixture repair' && test -z "$(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native status --porcelain)" && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false -C g5-native rev-parse HEAD
commands.retained: cd g5-native && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_bounded.py && test -z "$(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false status --porcelain)" && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.autocrlf=false -c commit.gpgsign=false rev-parse HEAD
commands.seedRed: cd g5-native && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_bounded.py >../g5-seed-tests.log 2>&1; status=$?; test "$status" -eq 1 && grep -q 'FAIL: test_negative' ../g5-seed-tests.log && grep -q 'Ran 3 tests' ../g5-seed-tests.log && printf 'G5-SEED-RED:negative-test-confirmed\n'
